title: ImprovementTrainingEvent
description: Allowlisted fictional improvement-event contract only. No collector, feature producer or export is enabled. Identifiers must be tenant-scoped pseudonyms; this shape alone is not an anonymity guarantee.

learnerKey.description: School-scoped keyed pseudonym, never an account ID, name or globally shared learner ID.

eventKey.description: School-scoped event pseudonym; not a raw progress event ID.

conceptKey.description: School-scoped reference to the approved concept mapping, not its title or question text.

occurredOn.description: UTC day only; no exact interaction timestamp.

classLevelBand.description: Optional approved school-placement context; never copied from questionnaire answers.

languageCode.description: Optional approved lesson language code, not a learner questionnaire answer.

connectivity.description: Optional measured interaction context, not reported home connectivity.
